title: Event venue: change of use of a farmhouse in a conservation district — Toa Baja
description: We want to convert an old coastal farmhouse in Toa Baja into an event venue for weddings. This is a change of use from residence to event venue, with a new parking area.

change_of_use.evidence: change of use from residence to event venue

mustInclude.rationale: RULE_0002 municipality baseline: every business gets the IRS EIN. (KB: RULE_0002, RULE_0620)
RULE_0003 municipality baseline: Registro de Comerciante (SURI). (KB: RULE_0003)
RULE_0651: new LLC -> Certificate of Organization (Departamento de Estado). (KB: RULE_0651)
RULE_0004 municipality baseline: Patente Municipal (Ley 107-2020 Codigo Municipal). (KB: RULE_0004)
RULE_0699: confirmed change of use -> new Permiso Unico for the new use. (KB: RULE_0007, RULE_0699)
RULE_0711: change of use at a pin in a conservation district (location.zoning.conservation) -> consulta de ubicacion. (KB: RULE_0709, RULE_0710, RULE_0711, RULE_0712)
RULE_0708: construction-type work at a pin in the coastal zone (location.czm) -> coastal-zone review (the rule itself flags EXPERT VALIDATION NEEDED). (KB: RULE_0708)

mustNotInclude.rationale: No renewable installation: RULE_0610 needs Q_RENEWABLE_INSTALL=true.
No renewable installation: RULE_0611 needs Q_RENEWABLE_INSTALL=true.
No microgrid stated: PT_MICROGRID needs microgrid_configuration=true; energy.test.ts: 'a rooftop system is not assumed to be a microgrid'.
No alcohol: RULE_0013/0014 need Q_ALCOHOL_SOLD / Q_ALCOHOL_SERVED; the business-type alcohol rules exist only for Bar / Juice Bar.

ordering.rationale: RC-2023: the consulta de ubicacion (land-use siting) is decided before the Permiso Unico for the new use (no KB edge).
KB documents.json: DOC_PATENTE_MUNICIPAL.depends_on_document_ids = [DOC_PERMISO_UNICO] (patente after the use permit).
